result.tbl:
(SELECT gin_modified_date,
        gin_modified_by,
        gin_doc_no,
        gin_bus_lvl1_code,
        gin_doc_type,
        gin_bus_lvl1_type,
        grn_doc_no,
        cm_created_date,
        cm_ref_no,
        cm_bus_lvl1_code,
        cm_doc_no,
        cm_doc_type,
        ssd_created_date,
        ssd_order_no,
        ssd_delivery_no,
        ssd_plant,
        ofd_delivery_note,
        ofd_has_error,
        ofd_error_msg,
        order_type,
        order_type_grn,
        OrderTypeZPIB,
        OrderTypeZPR,
        OrderTypeSOUpdate,
        ofd_po_number,
        DateFrom,
        DateTo
 FROM (SELECT distinct on (stoofd.tofd_po_number) gin_master.modified_date                                            as gin_modified_date,
                                                  gin_master.modified_by                                              as gin_modified_by,
                                                  gin_master.tgnm_docno                                               as gin_doc_no,
                                                  gnm2.tgnm_docno                                                     as grn_doc_no,
                                                  gin_master.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code                                as gin_bus_lvl1_code,
                                                  gin_master.pdot_docmtype                                            as gin_doc_type,
                                                  gin_master.pbet_busentity_type                                      as gin_bus_lvl1_type,
                                                  cm_master.create_date                                               as cm_created_date,
                                                  cm_master.tcmm_ref_no                                               as cm_ref_no,
                                                  cm_master.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code                                 as cm_bus_lvl1_code,
                                                  cm_master.tcmm_docno                                                as cm_doc_no,
                                                  cm_master.pdot_docmtype                                             as cm_doc_type,
                                                  ssd.create_date                                                     as ssd_created_date,
                                                  ssd.order_no                                                        as ssd_order_no,
                                                  ssd.delivery_no                                                     as ssd_delivery_no,
                                                  ssd.plnt                                                            as ssd_plant,
                                                  stoofd.tofd_delivery_note                                           as ofd_delivery_note,
                                                  stoofd.tofd_has_error                                               as ofd_has_error,
                                                  case
                                                      when stoofd.tofd_has_error = 'Y' then stoofd.tofd_error_msg
                                                      else 'SO Acknowledgement received successfully.' end            as ofd_error_msg,
                                                  case
                                                      when gin_master.pdot_docmtype = 'GN-01' and
                                                           gin_master.tgnm_ref_response_msg is not null
                                                          then 'ZPF' end                                              as order_type,
                                                  case
                                                      when gnm2.pdot_docmtype = 'GR-01' and gnm2.tgnm_ref_response_msg is not null
                                                          then 'ZPP' end                                              as order_type_grn,
                                                  case
                                                      when gin_master.tgnm_ref_response_msg_zpib is not null
                                                          then 'ZPIB' end                                             as OrderTypeZPIB,
                                                  case when gnm2.tgnm_ref_response_msg_zpr is not null then 'ZPR' end as OrderTypeZPR,
                                                  case
                                                      when cm_master.tcmm_docno is not null and
                                                           cm_master.tcmm_ref_response_msg is not null
                                                          then 'ZPI' end                                              as OrderTypeSOUpdate,
                                                  stoofd.tofd_po_number                                               as ofd_po_number,
                                                  cm_master.create_date                                               as DateFrom,
                                                  cm_master.create_date                                               as DateTo
       from snd_tr_ofd_order_file_detail stoofd
                left join snd_tr_cmm_cashmemo_master cm_master on cm_master.porg_orgacode = stoofd.porg_orgacode and
                                                                  cm_master.pbet_busentity_type = stoofd.tofd_entity_type and
                                                                  cm_master.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = stoofd.tofd_entity_code and
                                                                  cm_master.pdot_docmtype = 'CM-01' and
                                                                  cm_master.tcmm_ref_no = stoofd.tofd_po_number
                left join snd_tr_cmm_cashmemo_refinfo cm_ref_info
                          on cm_ref_info.porg_orgacode = cm_master.porg_orgacode and
                             cm_ref_info.pbet_busentity_type = cm_master.pbet_busentity_type and
                             cm_ref_info.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = cm_master.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code and
                             cm_ref_info.pdot_docmtype = cm_master.pdot_docmtype and
                             cm_ref_info.tcmm_docno = cm_master.tcmm_docno
                left join snd_tr_gnm_gingrn_master gin_master
                          on gin_master.porg_orgacode = cm_ref_info.porg_orgacode and
                             gin_master.pbet_busentity_type = cm_ref_info.pbet_busentity_type and
                             gin_master.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = cm_ref_info.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code and
                             gin_master.pdot_docmtype = cm_ref_info.tcmr_refdoctype and
                             gin_master.tgnm_docno = cm_ref_info.tcmr_refdocno
                left join snd_tr_gnm_gingrn_master gnm2 on gnm2.porg_orgacode = gin_master.porg_orgacode and
                                                           gnm2.pbet_busentity_type = gin_master.pbet_busentity_type and
                                                           gnm2.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = gin_master.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code and
                                                           gnm2.tgnm_tour_id = gin_master.tgnm_tour_id and
                                                           gnm2.tgnm_trip_id = gin_master.tgnm_trip_id and
                                                           gnm2.pdot_docmtype = 'GR-01'
                left join stg_so_delivery ssd on ssd.porg_orgacode = gin_master.porg_orgacode and
                                                 ssd.plnt = gin_master.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code and
                                                 COALESCE(gin_master.tgnm_ref_response_msg, '') ILIKE
                                                 '%' || ssd.order_no || '%' and
                                                 ssd.delivery_no = gin_master.tgnm_delivery_note_no
       WHERE cm_master.tcmm_docno is not null AND
             exists(select 1
                    from snd_tr_ofh_order_file_header stoofh
                    where stoofh.tofh_guid = stoofd.tofh_guid
                      and stoofh.tofh_process_status <> 'I'
                      and stoofh.tofh_file_name ilike 'API%'
                      AND cast(stoofh.create_date as date) BETWEEN'@Model(DateFrom)' AND '@Model(DateTo)')
       order by stoofd.tofd_po_number, stoofd.create_date desc) AA)
SSS

result.tbl:
SND_EN_PP1_PRF_BSEN_PHS_LVL1 bt
Left OUTER JOIN
snd_pr_geo_geog_hierarchy gh
    ON gh.porg_orgacode = bt.porg_orgacode AND gh.pgeo_geoghier_code = bt.pgeo_geoghier_code
  LEFT JOIN snd_pr_geo_geog_hierarchy_m ghl
    ON ghl.porg_orgacode = gh.porg_orgacode AND ghl.pgeo_geoghier_code = gh.pgeo_geoghier_code AND
       ghl.plng_langcode =  '@Session(languageCode)'
Left OUTER JOIN GLB_PR_LOC_LOCATION PLOC ON
PLOC.PORG_ORGACODE = bt.PORG_ORGACODE AND
PLOC.ploc_locacode = bt.ploc_locacode
         LEFT JOIN GLB_PR_LOC_LOCATION_M PLOCM ON PLOC.PORG_ORGACODE = PLOCM.PORG_ORGACODE

SND_EN_PJP_PJPHEAD PJP
         INNER JOIN SND_EN_OP1_OTH_BSEN_PHS_LVL1 PP1
                    ON PJP.PORG_ORGACODE = PP1.PORG_ORGACODE
                        AND PJP.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE = PP1.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE
                        AND PJP.EPP1_BUSENT_PHS_LVL1_CODE = PP1.EPP1_BUSENT_PHS_LVL1_CODE
         INNER JOIN SND_EN_PP2_PRF_BSEN_PHS_LVL2 DSR
                         ON DSR.PORG_ORGACODE = PJP.PORG_ORGACODE_PHS_LVL2_F
                             AND DSR.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE = PJP.PBET_BUSENT_TYPE_PHS_LVL2_F
                             AND DSR.EPP2_BUSENT_PHS_LVL2_CODE = PJP.EPP2_BUSENT_CODE_PHS_LVL2_F
         INNER join snd_pr_dst_dsrtype DSRTYPE
                         ON DSR.porg_orgacode = DSRTYPE.porg_orgacode
                         and DSR.pdst_dsr_type = DSRTYPE.pdst_dsr_type
         LEFT OUTER JOIN SND_EN_PP2_PRF_BSEN_PHS_LVL2_M DSRM
                         ON DSR.PORG_ORGACODE = DSRM.PORG_ORGACODE
                             AND DSR.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE = DSRM.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE
                             AND DSR.epp2_busent_phs_lvl2_code = DSRM.epp2_busent_phs_lvl2_code
                             AND DSRM.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
         LEFT OUTER JOIN GLB_PR_BNK_BANK BNK
                         ON BNK.PORG_ORGACODE = PJP.PORG_ORGACODE
                             AND BNK.PBNK_BANK_CODE = PJP.PBNK_BANK_CODE
         LEFT OUTER JOIN GLB_PR_BNK_BANK_M BNKM
                         ON BNK.PORG_ORGACODE = BNKM.PORG_ORGACODE
                             AND BNK.PBNK_BANK_CODE = BNKM.PBNK_BANK_CODE
                             AND BNKM.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
         LEFT OUTER JOIN GLB_PR_BNB_BANKBRANCH BNB
                         ON BNB.PORG_ORGACODE = PJP.PORG_ORGACODE
                             AND BNB.PBNK_BANK_CODE = PJP.PBNK_BANK_CODE
                             AND BNB.PBNB_BNBR_CODE = PJP.PBNB_BNBR_CODE
         LEFT OUTER JOIN GLB_PR_BNB_BANKBRANCH_M BNBM
                         ON BNB.PORG_ORGACODE = BNBM.PORG_ORGACODE
                             AND BNB.PBNK_BANK_CODE = BNBM.PBNK_BANK_CODE
                             AND BNB.PBNB_BNBR_CODE = BNBM.PBNB_BNBR_CODE
                             AND BNBM.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
         LEFT OUTER JOIN SND_EN_PJP_PJPHEAD_M PJPM
                         ON PJP.PORG_ORGACODE = PJPM.PORG_ORGACODE
                             AND PJP.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE = PJPM.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE
                             AND PJP.EPP1_BUSENT_PHS_LVL1_CODE = PJPM.EPP1_BUSENT_PHS_LVL1_CODE
                             AND PJP.EPJP_PJPNO = PJPM.EPJP_PJPNO
                             AND PJPM.PLNG_LANGCODE = '@Session(languageCode)'

result.tbl: ( select d.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code          as Depo_Code, d.epp1_desc                          as Depo_Name, p.epjp_pjpno                         as Driver_Code, p.epjp_desc                          as Driver_Name, c.tcet_trip_id                       as Trip_no, case when  gin.tgnm_status != 'C' and c.ptrs_trip_status = 'TE'  then 'Trip Ended' when  gin.tgnm_status != 'C' and c.ptrs_trip_status = 'TS' then 'Trip Started' when  gin.tgnm_status != 'C' and c.ptrs_trip_status = 'FC' then 'File Created - Trip not yet Started' when gin.tgnm_status = 'C' then 'Trip Terminated' else coalesce(t.ptrs_desc, c.ptrs_trip_status) end                              as Trip_Status_Description, c.ptrs_trip_status                   as Trip_Status, p.porg_orgacode                      as TXT__porg_orgacode, p.pbet_busentity_type                as TXT__pbet_busentity_type, cast(c.tcet_delivery_date as date)   as DT__delivery_date, p.modified_date                      as modified_date, gin.tgnm_docno                       as GIN_NUMBER, c.tcet_actual_trip_start_time ::time as start_time, c.tcet_actual_trip_end_time ::time   as end_time from snd_en_pjp_pjphead p inner join snd_en_pp1_prf_bsen_phs_lvl1 d on d.porg_orgacode = p.porg_orgacode and d.pbet_busentity_type = p.pbet_busentity_type and d.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = p.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code and d.porg_orgacode = '@Session(OrgaCode)' and d.pbet_busentity_type = 'DIST' and d.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = '@Session(DIST)' inner join snd_tr_cet_cashmemo_exe_tour c on c.porg_orgacode = d.porg_orgacode and d.pbet_busentity_type = c.pbet_busentity_type and d.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = c.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code and p.epjp_pjpno = c.epjp_pjpno and c.ptrt_tour_type = 'B' inner join glb_pr_trs_trip_status t on t.porg_orgacode = c.porg_orgacode and c.ptrs_trip_status = t.ptrs_trip_status left join snd_en_pjp_pjphead_m pm on p.porg_orgacode = pm.porg_orgacode and p.pbet_busentity_type = pm.pbet_busentity_type and p.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = pm.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code and p.epjp_pjpno = pm.epjp_pjpno inner join snd_tr_gnm_gingrn_master gin on gin.porg_orgacode = c.porg_orgacode and gin.pbet_busentity_type = c.pbet_busentity_type and gin.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = c.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code and gin.epjp_pjpno_daily = c.epjp_pjpno and gin.tgnm_tour_id = c.tcet_tour_id and gin.tgnm_trip_id = c.tcet_trip_id and gin.tgnm_delivery_date = c.tcet_delivery_date INNER JOIN SND_PR_DOT_DOCUMENTTYPE DOT ON DOT.PORG_ORGACODE = gin.PORG_ORGACODE AND DOT.PDOT_DOCMTYPE = gin.PDOT_DOCMTYPE AND DOT.PDOT_NATURE_IDENTIFIER = 'GN' ) x

result.tbl:
SND_EN_PP1_PRF_BSEN_PHS_LVL1 bt
Left OUTER JOIN   
snd_pr_geo_geog_hierarchy gh
    ON gh.porg_orgacode = bt.porg_orgacode AND gh.pgeo_geoghier_code = bt.pgeo_geoghier_code
  LEFT JOIN snd_pr_geo_geog_hierarchy_m ghl
    ON ghl.porg_orgacode = gh.porg_orgacode AND ghl.pgeo_geoghier_code = gh.pgeo_geoghier_code AND
       ghl.plng_langcode =  '@Session(languageCode)'
Left OUTER JOIN GLB_PR_LOC_LOCATION PLOC ON
PLOC.PORG_ORGACODE = bt.PORG_ORGACODE AND
PLOC.ploc_locacode = bt.ploc_locacode
         LEFT JOIN GLB_PR_LOC_LOCATION_M PLOCM ON PLOC.PORG_ORGACODE = PLOCM.PORG_ORGACODE
    AND PLOC.PLOC_LOCACODE = PLOCM.PLOC_LOCACODE AND PLOCM.PLNG_LANGCODE = '@Session(languageCode)'

SND_EN_PJP_PJPHEAD PJP
         INNER JOIN SND_EN_OP1_OTH_BSEN_PHS_LVL1 PP1
                    ON PJP.PORG_ORGACODE = PP1.PORG_ORGACODE
                        AND PJP.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE = PP1.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE
                        AND PJP.EPP1_BUSENT_PHS_LVL1_CODE = PP1.EPP1_BUSENT_PHS_LVL1_CODE
         INNER JOIN SND_EN_PP2_PRF_BSEN_PHS_LVL2 DSR
                         ON DSR.PORG_ORGACODE = PJP.PORG_ORGACODE_PHS_LVL2_F
                             AND DSR.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE = PJP.PBET_BUSENT_TYPE_PHS_LVL2_F
                             AND DSR.EPP2_BUSENT_PHS_LVL2_CODE = PJP.EPP2_BUSENT_CODE_PHS_LVL2_F
         INNER join snd_pr_dst_dsrtype DSRTYPE
                         ON DSR.porg_orgacode = DSRTYPE.porg_orgacode
                         and DSR.pdst_dsr_type = DSRTYPE.pdst_dsr_type
         LEFT OUTER JOIN SND_EN_PP2_PRF_BSEN_PHS_LVL2_M DSRM
                         ON DSR.PORG_ORGACODE = DSRM.PORG_ORGACODE
                             AND DSR.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE = DSRM.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE
                             AND DSR.epp2_busent_phs_lvl2_code = DSRM.epp2_busent_phs_lvl2_code
                             AND DSRM.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
         LEFT OUTER JOIN GLB_PR_BNK_BANK BNK
                         ON BNK.PORG_ORGACODE = PJP.PORG_ORGACODE
                             AND BNK.PBNK_BANK_CODE = PJP.PBNK_BANK_CODE
         LEFT OUTER JOIN GLB_PR_BNK_BANK_M BNKM
                         ON BNK.PORG_ORGACODE = BNKM.PORG_ORGACODE
                             AND BNK.PBNK_BANK_CODE = BNKM.PBNK_BANK_CODE
                             AND BNKM.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
         LEFT OUTER JOIN GLB_PR_BNB_BANKBRANCH BNB
                         ON BNB.PORG_ORGACODE = PJP.PORG_ORGACODE
                             AND BNB.PBNK_BANK_CODE = PJP.PBNK_BANK_CODE
                             AND BNB.PBNB_BNBR_CODE = PJP.PBNB_BNBR_CODE
         LEFT OUTER JOIN GLB_PR_BNB_BANKBRANCH_M BNBM
                         ON BNB.PORG_ORGACODE = BNBM.PORG_ORGACODE
                             AND BNB.PBNK_BANK_CODE = BNBM.PBNK_BANK_CODE
                             AND BNB.PBNB_BNBR_CODE = BNBM.PBNB_BNBR_CODE
                             AND BNBM.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
         LEFT OUTER JOIN SND_EN_PJP_PJPHEAD_M PJPM
                         ON PJP.PORG_ORGACODE = PJPM.PORG_ORGACODE
                             AND PJP.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE = PJPM.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE
                             AND PJP.EPP1_BUSENT_PHS_LVL1_CODE = PJPM.EPP1_BUSENT_PHS_LVL1_CODE
                             AND PJP.EPJP_PJPNO = PJPM.EPJP_PJPNO
                             AND PJPM.PLNG_LANGCODE = '@Session(languageCode)'
